summary: By October 2025, Cooke called for the U.S. to halt arms to Israel. Her October 2023 statement condemned HAMAS, said she 'stands with all civilians,' and criticized Rep. Van Orden's Israel trip as a 'renegade trip.' The record contains no explicit genocide acknowledgment, ceasefire advocacy, or pro-Palestine organizational endorsement. Her documented position opposes US military support for Israel but frames the conflict in general civilian-protection terms rather than explicitly Palestinian justice or anti-Zionist language.
